name: Microsoft SharePoint
label: Microsoft Graph SharePoint
description: Microsoft Graph SharePoint via OfficialApiNode. Base https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0. Docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/sharepoint?view=graph-rest-1.0 and https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/listitem-create?view=graph-rest-1.0. Prefer Sites.Selected. item_create/item_update send Graph fields (column map) plus Title. file_upload PUTs raw file bytes. Handler: OfficialApiNode. OUTPUT is {status,http_status,data}.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Microsoft SharePoint official API call. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Set operation plus the path/query/body fields that operation lists in api_spec.json. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"file_download"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official Graph call to run. EXACT: file_download | file_upload | file_update | item_create | item_get | item_list | item_update | item_delete | list_get | list_list. Example: item_create.

schema.label: site_id
schema.description: SharePoint site id (hostname,siteId,webId) for every path. Example: contoso.sharepoint.com,guid,guid. Config site_id is used when INPUT is empty.

schema.label: item_id
schema.description: Drive item id (file_*) or list item id (item_get/update/delete). Example: 01BYE5RZ6QN3ZWBTUFOFD3GSPGOHDJD36K.

schema.label: filename
schema.description: Server-relative file name for file_upload PUT /root:/{filename}:/content. Example: Reports/q1.xlsx.

schema.label: file
schema.description: File bytes for file_upload. Platform file list [{mime_type, source, data, name}]. Sent as the raw PUT body (application/octet-stream).

schema.label: name
schema.description: New drive-item name for file_update (PATCH item). Example: Q1-final.xlsx.

schema.label: list_id
schema.description: SharePoint list id (GUID) for item_* and list_get. Example: 22e03ef3-6ef4-424d-a1d3-92a337807c30.

schema.label: fields
schema.description: Column values object for item_create and item_update (Graph fieldValueSet). Keys are internal column names including Title. Example: {"Title":"Widget","Color":"Purple"}.

schema.label: $top
schema.description: Page size for item_list. Positive integer. Graph default 200. Example: 50.

schema.label: $skiptoken
schema.description: odata.nextLink skip token from a previous item_list. Example: 200.

schema.label: $expand
schema.description: OData $expand for item_get and item_list. EXACT common: fields | fields($select=Title,Color). Example: fields.

schema.label: $select
schema.description: OData $select for item_get and item_list. Comma-separated list item properties. Example: id,createdDateTime,fields.

schema.label: $filter
schema.description: OData $filter for item_list. Example: fields/Title eq 'Widget'.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Handler result object. Success: status='ok', http_status, data (parsed JSON). Example: {"status":"ok","http_status":200,"data":{}}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT value: 'ok'. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or the raw string when not JSON. Example: {}.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default official API call for this instance when input.operation is blank. EXACT accepted values: file_download, file_upload, file_update, item_create, item_get, item_list, item_update, item_delete, list_get, list_list. Default: file_download. Example: file_download.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: Provider credential for auth.type=bearer (configKey access_token). REQUIRED secret — StudioQuack secret binding only; never put this on INPUT. Never logged. Example: 'redacted-token'.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for the official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Example: 25.
